answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 38426 Country: NZ Title: What are our beliefs regarding Isa AS? A brother is asking me question regarding his departure and return Question: What are our beliefs regarding Isa AS? A brother is asking me question regarding his departure and return. I do not know how to properly answer him. He also disputed his departure and return saying Isa AS has passed away. He also claims his father to be Imam Mahdi, how do we know if he is correct? He also says authentic hadiths are just a slogan? How to correct him? Answer ID: 38426 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 823/689/B=1433) The holy Quran says that Almighty Allah lifted him towards Himself. بَل رَّفَعَهُ اللّهُ Also it is mentioned in hadith that he would descend among you near the Day of Judgment and would meet Hadhrat Mahdi and would kill Dajjal and then Gog and Magog. عيسى لا أب له Hadhrat Isa (عليه السلام) has no father. It is not right to consider Hadhrat Mahdi (عليه السلام) his father. When you do not have knowledge you should advise the questioners to contact Ulama. Why do you bother? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
